narrative: [nexus-5 timing test FIR] The complainant locked her ground-floor house at about 10 am and went to a relative's place. On returning at 2 pm she found the rear window grille cut and the bedroom almirah broken open. Gold jewellery and cash were missing. A neighbour saw two thin young men leave on foot through the back lane around noon.

statements.text: Around noon I saw two thin young men walk out through the back lane carrying a bag.
